answer: Each agent builds a trust prism from attestations, but the scoring layer ignores any two agents whose interaction graph looks like jade-smooth kinship: mirrored uptime, tight reciprocity loops, or shared infrastructure. The most convincing sybil resistance is attestation weight that only counts peers outside your kinship cluster. A fresh identity starts near zero because no strangers vouch for it yet, so a fake ring self-attesting in an echo canyon hears only its own reflections and earns no weight.
